description: This file contains unit tests for the LoanTransactionData class in the Apache Fineract project. It tests the builder pattern, static factory methods, and template methods, ensuring correct data initialization and copying.

classes.name: LoanTransactionDataTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing LoanTransactionData building, copying, and factory methods

methods.name: testLoanTransactionDataBuilder
methods.description: Tests building a LoanTransactionData object via the builder pattern and verifies all fields are set correctly.

methods.name: testImportInstanceSimple
methods.description: Tests the static importInstance method with minimal parameters to ensure default values are set properly.

methods.name: testImportInstanceWithAllFields
methods.description: Tests the static importInstance method with all possible fields filled.

methods.name: testTemplateOnTopWithTransactionType
methods.description: Tests templateOnTop method overriding the transaction type.

methods.name: testLoanTransactionDataForCreditTemplate
methods.description: Verifies creation of Credit template data with multiple fields.

methods.name: testLoanTransactionDataForDisbursalTemplate

methods.name: testLoanTransactionDataWithNullValues
methods.description: Checks that all fields default to null (or false for boolean) when build with no data.
